executable.renderer_note: Original renderer library from the first recording; new recorder/bootstrap diagnostic object. No acquired-BLIT or lazy-probe candidate.

qualifications: User reported no persistent drop; missing intervals cannot be certified.
No builds or benchmarks overlapped either manual user recording.
Second recording is not evidence that an experimental renderer fixed the first recording.
Model/focus flags are sampled at the current build boundary; build/end are previous-frame stages.
validation_requested=0 means the application did not request validation; forced loader layers were not recorded.
GPU adapter identity, clocks, actual enabled loader layers and external load were not recorded.
Window flags are SDL cached focus/visibility, not a full compositor visibility audit.
Thread CPU ticks have coarse Windows granularity; individual zero ticks do not prove idle.
Native submit/Present timers can overlap coarse stages; do not add them a second time.
Completed GPU timestamps are delayed and not necessarily busy-only GPU work.
Initial uncapped Overview window includes frame 293 VSync transition; no outlier discarded.
